Available 9th level · The one you don't take lightly

Large · Speed 25 ft · AC +2 item · +2 status to Fortitude · Melee vine-sweep (reach 15 ft, sweep) 3d8 bludgeoning · Grapple at reach
Green load

At the start of each of your turns, one 10-foot square within 30 feet that you can see becomes overgrown difficult terrain — permanently.

Grey load

Vine-sweep also deals 2d6 acid, and unattended metal it touches takes a permanent −1 item penalty as it corrodes through.
